title: Positivity of the gravitational path integral implies the axionic weak gravity conjecture
summary: The gravitational path integral can compute inner products between different states of open and closed universes. To have a well-defined Hilbert space, these inner products should be positive semi-definite, which is not manifest in the low-energy effective theory. In this letter, we analyze the constraints that the positivity of inner products imposes on gravitational theories coupled to axions.
